Name: FadeHelm's East Scarp anime style seasonal portrait
Author: FadeHelm
Description:
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]Since there are too few East Scarp portrait modules, why don't I create my own favorite portrait for him? So here I share my personal portraits. Since I like Ohodavi's anime-style portraits very much, I have been looking for replacements until I started to learn pixel painting, which is a gift for all people who like Ohodavi's paintings. Next, this mod will be constantly updated and improved until I am satisfied. Since my mod only supports seasonal clothing, I recommend other anime-style portraits here.[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22876]﻿Anime Seasonal Outfits[/url]（SDV）[/size][/center]
[center][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23543]Dawn's Ridgeside anime plan[/url]（RSV）
[/size]

[u][size=4]In addition, East Scarp's character needs this module as a prefix: [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp[/url][size=4]﻿,[/size][font=Arial][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43012]Drawberry's Seasonal Cuter Characters for ESR[/url][/font][size=4]，otherwise the portrait cannot be replaced correctly.[/size][/u][/center]

[center][/center]




[size=5]—Credit and permission— [/size]

[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat]Lemurkat [/url]allows me to use his resources and characters as the basis of this mod. [/size]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] thanks him for creating such a beautiful and rich character costume. I design portraits with his sprite. [/size]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/drawberry138]Drawberry[/url] thanks him for allowing me to design portraits with his sprite next. [/size]
